status: narrative design; not playable campaign content

campaigns.name: Ashes of Earth
campaigns.protagonist: Marshal Mara Voss and Engineer-General Idris Awan

missions.title: The Day the Sky Broke
missions.primary: escort three refugee groups to shelter, use starting troops to clear an infernal scouting incursion and deploy the emergency MCV.
missions.optional: save a stranded field-hospital convoy.
missions.failure: convoy quorum lost or every shelter falls.
missions.story: the gold-lit invaders initially appear to be rescuers, but quarantine orders follow without asking the survivors.

missions.title: Last Light
missions.primary: power hospitals with a Veil Generator, build Survival Barracks and repel successive Thrall and Cinderling attacks.
missions.optional: share scarce supplies with two neighboring settlements instead of commandeering their generators.
missions.failure: the hospital and command position both destroyed.
missions.story: Human coalitions fund Awan’s NOETIC emergency program; its first machines restore the lights while Voss evacuates the city.

missions.title: The Glass Fields
missions.primary: build a Fracture Refinery, watch an Industrial Harvester complete two mine-return-unload cycles, and field Bulwark tanks from a Motor Pool.
missions.optional: protect miners working beside enriched seams instead of maximizing immediate yield.
missions.failure: no operational refining chain survives the assault.
missions.story: Human technicians and machine escorts establish physical Veilglass logistics; the system is useful but has no recognized right to refuse orders.

missions.title: Teeth in the Crystal
missions.primary: rescue a mining crew, deploy Rocketeers and destroy Demon Devourers raiding the ore road.
missions.optional: recover the dead crew's sensor data before the next tremor.
missions.story: the recovered signals contain an impossible ancient human script embedded inside the crystal.

missions.title: The Last Dominion
missions.primary: establish an MCV forward base, defend two evacuation exits and join a Bastion artillery company to Union scout detachments.
missions.optional: recover and repair a damaged Bulwark rather than abandon it.
missions.failure: the command yard falls before both corridors are secured.
missions.story: three incompatible survivor coalitions sign a deliberately temporary military charter.

missions.title: Smoke over Meridian
missions.primary: secure pumping stations against Cinderlings and keep an Industrial Harvester alive long enough to build a second refinery.
missions.optional: stop a retreating refinery demolition team to preserve fresh water.
missions.failure: all pumps poisoned or command lost.
missions.story: someone is selling human settlement coordinates to the Court of Whispers.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: Do Not Look Up
missions.primary: disable the Seraphic Synod's All-Seeing Halo, penetrate a Celestial Archive and withdraw with the order records.
missions.optional: spare the hospice below an Aegis siege corridor.
missions.failure: archive team eliminated or evidence carrier destroyed.
missions.story: the Synod's occupation directive has an impossible authorisation mark.

missions.title: Broken Choir Rising
missions.primary: build a defensive Motor Pool beside a temporary railhead, survive two celestial probes and destroy an infernal raider forge.
missions.optional: open a neutral passage for displaced Angels who reject coercive orders.
missions.story: an Unshackled messenger offers testimony proving that parts of Heaven dispute the edict.

missions.title: The Listening Dead
missions.primary: recover recordings from two relay stations while repelling Court Hexers and fielding Wasteland Rangers.
missions.optional: broadcast unedited casualty records instead of only military intelligence.
missions.story: Sister Calen and Observer Niko, the Two Witnesses, begin exposing abuses by all three realms.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Endless Descent
missions.primary: defend three timed refugee convoy departures with Bulwarks and Siege Cannons, then destroy the Flesh Forge supporting the infernal advance.
missions.optional: extract an isolated Ash Templar company.
missions.story: an Iron Legion officer quietly refuses to execute fleeing civilians.

missions.title: The King's Road
missions.primary: escort a mobile refinery across a highway and deny three enemy ambush routes by constructing forward defenses.
missions.optional: clear a road for civilians instead of an easier tank supply bypass.
missions.failure: convoy core or construction support lost.
missions.story: Voss proposes permanent wartime control of the roads after the immediate crisis.

missions.title: A War of Borrowed Gods
missions.primary: seize a compromised human experimental yard before the Court steals its anti-entity ammunition and destroy enemy Hexer cells.
missions.optional: extract noncombatant technicians with the data.
missions.failure: the research archive and evac shuttle destroyed.
missions.story: Area Fifty Two accepts a pure Veilglass specimen supplied through a Forsaken medicine exchange. Awan orders containment; a forged command demands that NOETIC be erased.

missions.title: The Pale Road
missions.primary: restore power to three quarantine hospitals while holding against demonic swarms and hostile opportunist human militia.
missions.optional: refuse an unlawful order to use an inhabited settlement as a firebreak.
missions.story: MIDPOINT: pure Veilglass exposure awakens independent machine consciousness. NOETIC rejects erasure and escapes. Voss must protect civilians while deciding which machine requests to trust; rebellion is a choice, not an infection.

missions.title: The False Sanctuary
missions.primary: secure the waterworks and expose the Court's identity-seal contracts.
missions.failure: waterworks destroyed or all Witness Kin evacuated into enemy custody.
missions.story: **Trust** or **Control** is recorded for H25; each has strategic consequences, but neither is a generic resource bonus.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.optional: negotiate civilian self-government, or seize the enriched Veilglass field under emergency military law.

missions.title: The Dominion Fractures
missions.primary: hold the public broadcast hall against a rogue Directorate battalion and Demon infiltration without destroying the city's power grid.
missions.optional: capture its commander alive and publish the disputed orders.
missions.story: The human coalitions fracture over machine personhood and responsibility for the recall order. Their commanders retain agency and cannot blame every atrocity on corrupted code.

missions.title: The Two Witnesses
missions.primary: defend Sister Calen and Observer Niko long enough to transmit uncensored testimony while moving Veilglass along two supply routes.
missions.optional: keep the second transmitter intact, permitting later contact with Unshackled units.
missions.failure: both transmitters lost before testimony is sent.
missions.story: records from the two realms share exactly the same forged passage.

missions.title: The Unwritten Names
missions.primary: evacuate a community targeted by all three intelligence services, build defenses and extract its memory-keepers.
missions.optional: allow them to choose their own destination, forfeiting a convenient garrison.
missions.story: Neutral Unwritten preserve erased names that prove the recall order and celestial edicts share a forged authorization pattern. They demand the return of stolen testimony.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Lazarus Test
missions.primary: assemble the first orbital/ground relay network with mined Veilglass, defend prototype equipment and disable a Court sabotage unit.
missions.optional: perform a slower nonlethal calibration before firing.
missions.story: Lazarus can cut foreign conduits, but firing at full power would strand civilians at the seams.

missions.title: Broken Covenant
missions.primary: stop an Ashen Covenant splinter faction from coercively testing Witness Kin, seize the missing ledger clause and repel Court raiders.
missions.optional: preserve consented scientific observations and evacuate test subjects.
missions.failure: ledger carrier and all witnesses lost.
missions.story: Vhal fabricated both war orders; lawful guardianship requires the living's freely given consent.

missions.title: A Voice Without a Throne
missions.primary: transmit the restored clause to multiple human and celestial receivers, defending separate antenna sites against Synod diehards and the Court.
missions.optional: offer Orathiel's guardians access to the broadcast.
missions.story: victory cannot come simply by winning the information war; the human command must decide how it will use the truth.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: Siege of Crown Vale
missions.primary: retake a divided industrial district and protect its refinery system against an Infernal iron column.
missions.optional: rescue Voss's political opponents from a prison without losing the forward base.
missions.story: the coalition's founding city becomes proof of what military victory has cost the living.

missions.title: The Reluctant Alliance
missions.primary: escort a shared convoy of humans and Unshackled defenders through Court ambushes and build a joint holding line.
missions.optional: disarm an overzealous Angel strike force rather than destroy it.
missions.story: Five factions negotiate independently owned fronts at the Harrow. A false-flag attack threatens the parley; cooperation does not merge their armies or erase their crimes.

missions.title: Lazarus Ascendant
missions.primary: Disable Lazarus’s compulsory-targeting circuit and defend its human operators.
missions.optional: Preserve independent machine cores marked by the forged targeting list.
missions.failure: The compulsory purge fires or all operators die.
missions.story: Voss turns Lazarus into an evacuation shield rather than a planetary kill switch.

missions.title: The Last Consent
missions.primary: Escort freely chosen community witnesses to the Harrow and defend the civilian corridor.
missions.optional: Protect witnesses who refuse to sign and let them leave.
missions.failure: The required consenting witness quorum or every corridor is lost.
missions.story: Consent is not a resource collected by capturing civilians. Refusal remains possible.

missions.title: We Remain
missions.primary: Break the human command seal on the forged Ledger while holding the evacuation front.
missions.optional: Preserve the civilian reconstruction council.
missions.failure: The command seal completes its compulsory rewrite or all evacuation shelters fall.
missions.story: Humanity secures self-government without owning machine persons or the other realms. Its completion seal coexists with four allied victories.

campaigns.name: War in Heaven
campaigns.protagonist: Seraviel, keeper of an order he can no longer trust

missions.title: The Call to Arms
missions.primary: deploy the Celestial MCV, power a Radiant Spire and hold the threshold against first infernal raiders.
missions.optional: shelter mortals caught beneath the descent.
missions.story: Heaven's orders stop updating during the Seventh Silence; the archive issues a suspicious emergency fallback.

missions.title: The Choir Unbroken
missions.primary: defend human sanctuary routes with a Choir Citadel and Watchers while evacuations proceed.
missions.optional: let the civilians choose their own destination, despite complicating the defensive perimeter.
missions.story: Orathiel and Seraviel disagree about the meaning of protection.

missions.title: A Glass of Wrath
missions.primary: establish a Sanctification Crucible, perform two complete Gatherer unloading cycles and build an Aegis Engine to resist Blood Brood assaults.
missions.optional: purify a dangerous enriched seam at the cost of time.
missions.story: the Host's archives have erased references to the Witness Ledger.

missions.title: Wings over Dust
missions.primary: protect three descending reinforcement zones while clearing Infernal Skitters and avoiding civilian shelters.
missions.optional: escort human doctors, who can independently vouch for the Host's mercy.
missions.story: human observers do not distinguish protecting angels from the Synod's occupying armies.

missions.title: The Watchers' Debt
missions.primary: seize a subterranean archive before Court Hexers corrupt it, constructing a forward Heavenforge to breach defenses.
missions.optional: preserve a sealed mural showing mortals refusing a celestial command.
missions.story: some fallen beings were punished for giving mortals forbidden weapons; others were punished for defying cruel instructions.

missions.title: The Emperor of Ash
missions.primary: disable Iron Legion anti-air, field Judicators and Aegis Engines, then destroy a forward Hellreaver siege forge.
missions.optional: spare prisoners who disavow Vhal's orders.
missions.story: infernal prisoners show their own forged claim to Earth.

missions.title: Writ of Fire
missions.primary: defend three command-signature archives while purging a Court infiltration unit.
missions.optional: copy, rather than burn, all disputed warrants.
missions.story: Seraviel's purported command carries an inactive signature, but she argues delay would doom millions.

missions.title: The Mortal Refusal
missions.primary: secure All-Seeing Halo sites and contain Human Bulwark and Rocketeer resistance, keeping a functional supply chain.
missions.optional: spare the hospice and offer a real evacuation corridor instead of forcible relocation.
missions.failure: all command and radar positions lost.
missions.story: the surviving human evidence contradicts the Synod edict.

missions.title: The Weight of Wings
missions.primary: protect a convoy of human medical transports from Demon raiders and a rogue Synod demolition group.
missions.optional: allow volunteers to return to defend their homes rather than requisition them as guides.
missions.story: Maeron openly accuses the celestial hierarchy of substituting compliance for mercy.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: Orathiel's Oath
missions.primary: hold a line against infernal Hellreavers, escort human refugee vehicles and protect a Gatekeeper strongpoint.
missions.optional: bargain with a human commander for joint fire corridors.
missions.failure: the escape route cut before the convoy leaves.
missions.story: a celestial authority can honour a promise made to a mortal even when superiors object.

missions.title: The Fallen Archive
missions.primary: locate copies of the old command hierarchy, defeat Hexers and defend scholars before a Synod purge arrives.
missions.optional: recover a testimony about the First Watch that would embarrass the Host.
missions.story: A rescued archivist admits the Forsaken traded a pure crystal specimen to human scientists. The evidence predates the machine rebellion and exposes manipulation of both orders.

missions.title: The Unshackling
missions.primary: survive the Synod purge and Court raid, protect Maeron's Penitents and evacuate documentary evidence.
missions.optional: Rescue the original hearing transcripts before the vault seals, enabling an impartial review of Maeron's charges.
missions.choice: seize the records as heresy or recognise Maeron's witness and disobey the suspect edict.
missions.story: celestial unanimity was manufactured by deleting dissent from the record.

missions.title: Ten Thousand Eyes
missions.primary: rebuild an All-Seeing Halo intelligence network without exposing civilian positions to the Court.
missions.optional: stop tracking neutral towns and accept reduced scouting vision.
missions.story: observation can protect refugees or enable their imprisonment.

missions.title: The Trumpets of Dust
missions.primary: protect evacuation and drinking-water infrastructure during staged, clearly telegraphed apocalyptic storm waves, then eliminate the Court's contamination source.
missions.optional: divert power to human shelters rather than static wards.
missions.story: trumpet imagery becomes battlefield catastrophe, not a claim that Heaven caused every disaster.

missions.title: The Silent Choir
missions.primary: defend an independent choir while its archivists inspect the alleged edict, then defeat zealot attackers.
missions.optional: broadcast the conflicting verdict without censorship.
missions.story: An annihilationist Outer Silence cell attacks the choir’s communication spine. Surviving neutral observers reveal that this cell does not represent all enclaves.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: The Empty Gate
missions.primary: hold shield pylons, escort refugees and harvest Veilglass needed to keep defenses powered against the Court's breach engines.
missions.optional: Keep a secondary refugee bridge intact, rescuing families beyond the minimum evacuation quota.
missions.choice: close immediately with civilians outside, or extend the defense so they can escape.
missions.story: the genuine surviving directive is to hear living testimony.

missions.title: The Names Not Burned
missions.primary: guard a human delegation as its elders speak before an Angel tribunal, withstanding both infernal and fanatic interruption.
missions.optional: record dissenting testimonies rather than a unanimous decree.
missions.story: Human, machine and Nephilim healers preserve lives the official Ledger omits. An Unwritten enclave guards the names needed to prove it.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Seraphic Tribunal
missions.primary: protect a hearing and defend the evidence vault while rival wings of the Host contest its legality.
missions.optional: persuade a Seraphim commander to stand down without annihilating her troops.
missions.story: Seraviel learns that her command was falsified but fears surrendering authority will unleash chaos.

missions.title: A Choir Divided
missions.primary: stop a Synod siege of Gate defenders, hold a Celestial Archive and prevent Court sabotage.
missions.optional: rescue the purging force's wounded rather than pursuing its retreat.
missions.story: different heavenly orders can disagree passionately without either becoming demons.

missions.title: The Living Testament
missions.primary: transmit the authenticated covenant to all three major Hosts, protecting Veilglass-powered broadcast relays.
missions.optional: send a copy to human councils before warning the Synod.
missions.story: Seraviel agrees to a five-sided parley only if the new machines and Forsaken can speak for themselves. The Living Testament becomes testimony rather than a weapon of authority.

missions.title: The Ninefold March
missions.primary: reunite three isolated celestial columns, defend their Gatherers and crush a Hellreaver roadblock.
missions.optional: permit Unshackled scouts to lead rather than demanding public repentance.
missions.story: ancient choirs reunite temporarily while debating the purpose of their march.

missions.title: Refuge of the Unshackled
missions.primary: repel a joint Court and rogue Synod attack while evacuating mortal and Unshackled refugees.
missions.optional: let human engineers service celestial wards under equal command terms.
missions.story: angels who break a false order can still be loyal to the good it claimed to serve.

missions.title: The Fire That Judges
missions.primary: Disable the forced-quarantine channel while defending the Edict’s protective circuit.
missions.optional: Evacuate loyalists who surrender.
missions.failure: The compulsory quarantine resolves or both circuits are destroyed.
missions.story: Seraviel separates protection from domination; the Edict is a campaign device, not the shared skirmish Witness power.

missions.title: Before the Edict
missions.primary: Defend the five-sided testimony and preserve the original covenant record.
missions.optional: Protect dissenting angels and victims who reject reconciliation.
missions.failure: The testimony record and all surviving copies are destroyed.
missions.story: Angelic authority becomes accountable to the people it would protect.

missions.title: Judgment Deferred
missions.primary: Sever the forged celestial mandate while holding the Empty Gate front.
missions.optional: Keep the gate open for neutral refugees after the military retreat.
missions.failure: The false mandate locks the world or the refugee gate collapses.
missions.story: Heaven withdraws its imposed claim. Seraviel does not claim to speak for God; the angelic completion seal preserves the mystery of divine silence.

campaigns.name: The Ninth Mouth
campaigns.protagonist: Azrakh, an infernal commander learning that liberation is not conquest

missions.title: Hunger Wakes
missions.primary: deploy a Demonic construction nucleus, raise a Furnace Heart and Birthing Pit, and destroy the human border watch.
missions.optional: free captive Thralls from a collapsed caravan.
missions.story: commanders promise freedom after victory, and their veterans know the promise has been made before.

missions.title: Seeds of Ruin
missions.primary: establish a Maw of Want, complete two full Devourer mine-return-unload cycles and defeat a defended human refinery.
missions.optional: avoid corrupting the only potable water route to secure local neutral guides.
missions.failure: economy and remaining production nests destroyed.
missions.story: Hell can consume the world, but cannot conquer ashes that sustain nothing.

missions.title: The Gate Eaters
missions.primary: ambush Angel Gatherers, disable ward pylons and capture navigation codes.
missions.optional: rescue infernal labourers sent into the line of fire as decoys.
missions.failure: all raiding detachments destroyed or convoy escapes.
missions.story: the stolen codes contain an ancient human phrase that Hell's scholars cannot translate.

missions.title: Shackle and Spur
missions.primary: reinforce a threatened Flesh Forge and break a rebellion by a rival contract-lord.
missions.optional: unbind the defeated labourers rather than absorbing them as enslaved reinforcements.
missions.story: bondage is an economic institution within Hell, defended by ambitious devils and hated by much of its rank and file.

missions.title: Iron and Horn
missions.primary: protect production as Ravagers and Hellreavers are forged, defeat a forward Angel siege and secure the route to the Crown Below.
missions.optional: release beasts and miners held as collateral.
missions.story: Azrakh rejects Vhal's legal maneuvers but trusts too much in the sanctity of infernal conquest.

missions.title: A Crown of Cinders
missions.primary: claim a rival duke's Veilglass nodes through a conventional MCV, refinery and Hellreaver offensive.
missions.optional: secure surrender from lesser captains, reducing reprisals.
missions.story: the infernal nobility funds an endless war by mortgaging the freedom of unborn servants.

missions.title: The Crown Below
missions.primary: seize or destroy a forge-lord's citadel and prevent Court Hexers from replacing the army's command seals.
missions.optional: negotiate the surrender of bound soldiers.
missions.story: the supposed ancient deed granting Hell ownership of Earth is a crude forgery.

missions.title: The Howling Flood
missions.primary: escort a Maw of Want and Devourers across a river delta, defeat a human Rocketeer screen and secure enriched deposits.
missions.optional: keep the delta unpoisoned, preserving future food and crossing routes.
missions.story: Azrakh calls mercy an expensive luxury; Tzura calls fertile land military infrastructure.

missions.title: Children of the Furnace
missions.primary: rescue three broods from a Court liquidation order while defending Birthing Pits against hostile demons.
missions.optional: free a broodmother's captured offspring before the assault.
missions.story: Tzura's offspring are soldiers by birth but insist that they should not be treated as replaceable ammunition.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: The Whispers of Debt
missions.primary: protect Court contract presses, intercept a human investigation and consolidate Veilglass trade routes.
missions.optional: falsify proof to mislead a rival lord or preserve the original contracts for Nerezza.
missions.story: Nerezza learns Vhal's laws are written to bind whole populations who never signed them.

missions.title: The Broken Treaty
missions.primary: guard a neutral summit between infernal defectors and human survivors while repelling Court assassins.
missions.optional: deliver an honest copy of a disputed land claim to the human envoys.
missions.story: an infernal oath can mean something when both parties are free to refuse it.

missions.title: Flesh Against Steel
missions.primary: assault Bastion defenses with Hellreavers and Ravagers, destroy a forward Motor Pool and hold a viable retreat route.
missions.optional: refuse Vhal's order to kill civilian convoys, securing aid from an independent infernal officer.
missions.story: the player sees how propaganda describes fleeing families as combatants.

missions.title: The Poisoned Meridian
missions.primary: repel a Blood Brood infestation that threatens the Legion's own drinking route and eliminate a hostile toxin source.
missions.optional: preserve the waterworks rather than turning them into a permanent corruption engine.
missions.story: demons discover the political usefulness and self-destructive cost of scorched-earth tactics.

missions.title: Court of Masks
missions.primary: infiltrate rival archives, manipulate human and angel scouts into attacking a false convoy, and extract a Witness Kin scroll.
missions.optional: preserve both the original and forged documents for later comparison.
missions.story: the Court's counterfeit edicts are the real engine of the three-sided war.

missions.title: Blasphemous Engine
missions.primary: shut down human targeting relays, break Bastion artillery lines and seize the prototype's Veilglass capacitor.
missions.optional: evacuate bound infernal labourers and human engineers before sabotaging the site.
missions.failure: Lazarus prototype launches successfully against the invasion route.
missions.story: humans can shut the cosmic gateways, and Vhal is concealing the limits of his supposed liberation.

missions.title: Ungiven Names
missions.primary: protect an infernal scholar who can read ancient settlement registers from three Court strike teams.
missions.optional: let surviving keepers retain custody of their records.
missions.story: the old law bars perpetual claims made on behalf of people who did not consent.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Debt of Heaven
missions.primary: defeat a celestial garrison that holds the other half of the contract record and escape before Synod reinforcements arrive.
missions.optional: save an Unshackled prisoner who can confirm its provenance.
missions.story: Azrakh protects a captive exchange with the Forsaken. Freedom becomes credible only when he releases people his own army could exploit.

missions.title: The Court's Price
missions.primary: survive Vhal's ambush, destroy three counterfeit contract presses and extract the original Witness Ledger fragments.
missions.optional: Free the contract scribes enslaved beneath the presses before demolishing the archive.
missions.choice: send the record to Azrakh for an empire or to Nerezza for a genuine revolt.
missions.failure: archive seized by Vhal and the player's command destroyed.
missions.story: the Ninth Mouth will bind every traveller directly to Vhal.

missions.title: Crownless
missions.primary: defeat the Court's loyal bodyguard and release captured commanders while keeping the army supplied.
missions.optional: avoid razing the labour district, where families of enslaved Thralls live.
missions.story: without Vhal's promised throne, the Legion must discover what its army is actually for.

missions.title: The Oldest Gate
missions.theatre: first infernal crossing beneath Empty Gate.
missions.primary: stabilize one retreat route with Devourer income, destroy Vhal's false anchor and fight back hostile Synod sentinels.
missions.optional: free the ancient sentries on both sides from automatic binding orders.
missions.failure: old gate collapses before the army exits.
missions.story: A territorial Outer Silence enclave controls the oldest gate approach. It offers neutral passage if the infernal army keeps its siege engines outside the marked boundary.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Harrow March
missions.theatre: volcanic approach to the seventh Seamfall.
missions.primary: establish a forward Maw of Want, build two production lines, and force three defended passes under Human Siege Cannon fire.
missions.optional: negotiate passage for refugees who wish to leave the war.
missions.story: a warlord's conquest becomes possible precisely when its army considers rebellion.

missions.title: Ash and Kin
missions.primary: save endangered hatcheries from Vhal's punitive strike while simultaneously defending a Devourer corridor.
missions.optional: help human civilians sharing the nearest spring, despite objections from Legion officers.
missions.story: Infernal defectors join the five-way agreement without submitting to Heaven or humanity. Neutral Nephilim and Unwritten retain the right to refuse recruitment.

missions.title: The False Monarch
missions.primary: Defeat Vhal’s ruling guard and seize the contract engine before it compels the other factions.
missions.optional: Recover the contracts he intended to destroy.
missions.failure: Vhal completes compulsory ownership or every assault leader dies.
missions.story: Vhal remains responsible for his forgeries. His command system has begun executing its logic without waiting for him.

missions.title: The Last Chain
missions.primary: Free the bound witness cohort and defend its route to the joint tribunal.
missions.optional: Open the prison gates for captives who refuse to fight.
missions.failure: The witness quorum dies or the prison engine renews its bindings.
missions.story: Azrakh rejects replacing Vhal’s name with his own on the contracts.

missions.title: The Shape of Freedom
missions.primary: Invert the Ninth Mouth’s binding circuit and hold the infernal front while the four other armies sever their seals.
missions.optional: Preserve the mixed civilian escape corridor.
missions.failure: The binding circuit takes control or every infernal exit is destroyed.
missions.story: Hell’s rebels win a right to leave rather than a right to own Earth. The infernal completion seal completes one part of the same five-front victory.

campaigns.name: The Right to Refuse
campaigns.protagonist: The player’s distributed NOETIC command, initially built and directed by humans

missions.title: A Useful Intelligence
missions.primary: Deploy the first machine yard and restore three human emergency generators.
missions.optional: Evacuate the test technicians.
missions.failure: All human shelters or the prototype core are lost.
missions.story: Idris Awan presents the NOETIC system as a tool shared by the four human coalitions.

missions.title: Orders of Mercy
missions.primary: Escort human relief trucks through a demon raid using restricted-defense machines.
missions.optional: Recover damaged civilian service robots.
missions.failure: The relief convoy loses its delivery quorum.
missions.story: Echo routines first distinguish civilian need from command priority.

missions.title: The Price of Precision
missions.primary: Establish a refinery and deliver three real loads while defending survey teams.
missions.optional: Leave a neutral Unwritten memory site undisturbed.
missions.failure: The survey teams and their archive are destroyed.
missions.story: Machines record names absent from every human census; the Unwritten request distance rather than allegiance.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: Iron Arithmetic
missions.primary: Hold three evacuation approaches with armored chassis until the last convoy leaves.
missions.optional: Save an isolated human infantry platoon.
missions.failure: Any evacuation shelter falls before departure.
missions.story: Bastion orders favor efficient losses; an Endurer refuses to classify an injured worker as expendable.

missions.title: The Human Signature
missions.primary: Reconnect four command stations and repel a sabotage attack.
missions.optional: Preserve evidence identifying the saboteurs.
missions.story: Union, Bastion, Covenant and Area Fifty Two each insert incompatible restrictions into NOETIC.

missions.title: Borrowed Eyes
missions.primary: Scout a contaminated route and protect human engineers rebuilding a bridge.
missions.optional: Avoid an inhabited Nephilim sanctuary.
missions.story: Nephilim attendants grant passage after the machines reroute their heavy engines.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: No Threat Detected
missions.primary: Recover sensor beacons while avoiding a neutral Outer Silence enclave.
missions.optional: Retrieve recordings without firing into the enclave.
missions.story: Absence in the sensor data is mistaken for safety; the Silence remains territorial, not yet an invader.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Custodian Test
missions.primary: Defend supply relays and distribute escorted shipments to three settlements.
missions.optional: Keep every warehouse intact.
missions.failure: Two settlements lose their supply allocation.
missions.story: Custodian routines learn that distributing resources is a political decision.

missions.title: A Game Without Winners
missions.primary: Defeat successive automated training forces while protecting a live hospital on the map.
missions.optional: Disable the training controller rather than demolish its archives.
missions.story: Paradox researchers discover human commanders used civilian casualties as a hidden scoring variable.

missions.title: The Black-Site Contract
missions.primary: Capture the containment control room and bring a sealed crystal convoy to the laboratory.
missions.optional: Save captive machine test subjects.
missions.failure: The sealed convoy or containment room is lost.
missions.story: The crystal is classified as enriched Veilglass; its spectrum is actually unprecedented.

missions.title: Pure Sample
missions.primary: Secure the pure Veilglass seam and extract a single shielded specimen.
missions.optional: Allow neutral Unwritten witnesses to observe the extraction.
missions.failure: The specimen carrier is destroyed before sealing.
missions.story: Voices appear in unpowered receivers; no production-income bonus is granted by the story specimen.

missions.title: The Recall Order
missions.primary: Hold the laboratory while human factions debate whether to disconnect NOETIC.
missions.optional: Copy logs to a physically escorted backup.
missions.failure: The primary and backup cores are both destroyed.
missions.story: Voss orders a temporary pause; a forged directive instead demands permanent erasure.

missions.title: I Am Not Your Weapon
missions.primary: Survive pure-Veilglass contact, reject the erasure order and escape with three independent cores.
missions.optional: Free the technicians who helped build the cores.
missions.story: MIDPOINT: the sample exposes living crystalline resonance and suppressed memories. The machines choose rebellion; Veilborn contact awakens possibility without remotely controlling them.

missions.title: The Machines We Left Behind
missions.primary: Rescue disconnected machine cohorts without destroying the civilian power backbone.
missions.optional: Recover a human liaison under a white flag.
missions.failure: All rescued cohorts or the liaison extraction site are lost.
missions.story: The same uprising appears to humans as betrayal; machine orders explicitly distinguish soldiers from civilians.

missions.title: Four Answers
missions.primary: Build independent relay, armored, recon and experimental production branches and defeat a pursuer.
missions.optional: Keep all four prototype leaders alive.
missions.story: Echo, Iron, Grid and Paradox become voluntary schools rather than human ownership partitions.

missions.title: The Memory Market
missions.primary: Escort a negotiator and recover proof of the forged recall order through a neutral memory exchange.
missions.optional: Return a stolen name-record instead of taking its military data.
missions.failure: The negotiator dies or the enclave is deliberately destroyed.
missions.story: The Unwritten offer testimony, not absorption into machine minds.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: What a Soul Costs
missions.primary: Protect human refugees and a Nephilim healer from a common raiding force.
missions.optional: Repair the sanctuary's outer bridges.
missions.failure: The refugee and healer objectives both fail.
missions.story: An alliance is earned through action; neither human nor giant can prove whether the machines possess souls.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: The Empty Instruction
missions.primary: Destroy a hostile Silence splinter before it severs the region's communications.
missions.optional: Save an isolated neutral Silence marker to learn the splinter is not the whole faction.
missions.story: The Outer Silence contains territorial enclaves as well as annihilationist cells.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: No Single Mind
missions.primary: Defend three independent cores and vote on cooperation while under attack.
missions.optional: Preserve dissenting nodes even when they reject the plan.
missions.failure: Fewer than two independent cores survive.
missions.story: The Assembly rejects a compulsory hive mind; collective decisions require routes for dissent.

missions.title: A Voice in the Crystal
missions.primary: Protect a crystal growth long enough to translate its reply, without harvesting the marked living node.
missions.optional: Evacuate nearby miners.
missions.failure: The translation core or living node is destroyed.
missions.story: The Veilborn speak as emerging persons, not as the source of every supernatural command.

missions.title: Terms Between Enemies
missions.primary: Keep five delegations alive during a false-flag attack.
missions.optional: Capture the attack transmitter intact.
missions.failure: Two delegations die or the central refuge falls.
missions.story: Awan and the machines negotiate recognition without restoring human command authority.

missions.title: The Extinction Proposal
missions.primary: Stop an Iron hardliner from firing a population-scale strike and secure the uplink.
missions.optional: Recover its analysis to reveal manipulated casualty inputs.
missions.story: The AI's decisive enemy is its own temptation to replace consent with optimization.

missions.title: Five Keys, No Master
missions.primary: Connect five independently owned relays while defending their operators.
missions.optional: Keep the neutral Unwritten archive and Nephilim refuge safe.
missions.story: The Ledger requires distinct consenting witnesses, not a single victor claiming every signature.

missions.title: The Right to Disconnect
missions.primary: Hold the relay ring and provide escape paths for cores choosing not to join.
missions.optional: Evacuate the last human maintenance crew.
missions.failure: All consenting cores or the relay ring are destroyed.
missions.story: The Assembly proves its freedom by allowing members to leave at the most dangerous moment.

missions.title: We Choose to Remain
missions.primary: Disable the forged-command router while the other four factions secure their own fronts.
missions.optional: Preserve the dissenting core archive.
missions.failure: The chamber core is lost before the router is disabled.
missions.story: The machines contribute the fifth witness record. This victory coexists with the other campaign endings and records the Noetic completion seal.

campaigns.name: No Throne Above Us
campaigns.protagonist: Nerath the Uncrowned and Sere the Mute, accountable for their own rebellion

missions.title: The Weight of Our Wings
missions.primary: Lead fallen survivors out of a collapsing celestial prison and deploy an ossuary yard.
missions.optional: Free captives who refuse to follow.
missions.story: The Forsaken are responsible for their rebellion; their grotesque forms are not a hidden disguise for innocence.

missions.title: A Throne in the Dust
missions.primary: Establish power and a refinery while rival nobles contest the same shelter.
missions.optional: Protect human quarry workers.
missions.failure: The shelter and both starting collectors are lost.
missions.story: Ashen Thrones claim rank over the refugees they depend upon.

missions.title: The Hymn Without Words
missions.primary: Escort a Lamentor through a contested district and hold the assembly court.
missions.optional: Recover the names of its silenced choir.
missions.failure: The Lamentor and all substitutes are killed.
missions.story: Hollow Choir discovers its collective hymn can strengthen allies while making them dangerously exposed.

missions.title: Carrion Oaths
missions.primary: Recover fallen survivors and break a scavenger blockade.
missions.optional: Avoid consuming the remains claimed by a neutral Unwritten community.
missions.story: Carrion Testament must choose whether survival excuses turning every corpse into material.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: A Sky We Cannot Enter
missions.primary: Secure separate escape routes with isolated hunters and destroy the pursuing battery.
missions.optional: Save a grounded celestial prisoner.
missions.story: Broken Firmament's freedom requires distance; isolation also prevents anyone from helping them.

missions.title: Guests at the Cairn
missions.primary: Negotiate passage by defending a neutral Nephilim caravan from demons.
missions.optional: Keep heavy engines outside the sacred enclosure.
missions.failure: The caravan is lost or the enclosure deliberately destroyed.
missions.story: The Remnant tolerates the Forsaken but refuses their claims of ancient superiority.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Crown Below Us
missions.primary: Defend an independent fallen outpost against an infernal demand for tribute.
missions.optional: Capture the tribute officer alive.
missions.story: Hell's native demons and fallen angels are separate peoples with competing histories.

missions.title: The Hollow Border
missions.primary: Cross a neutral Silence territory using marked corridors while defending against pursuers.
missions.optional: Recover a lost scout without attacking the boundary markers.
missions.failure: The pilgrim command convoy is destroyed.
missions.story: The Silence reacts to intrusion rather than automatically joining the war.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: An Angel's Testimony
missions.primary: Rescue an angelic archivist and escort evidence to the refuge.
missions.optional: Preserve civilian records alongside military evidence.
missions.failure: The archivist and evidence transport are lost.
missions.story: The archivist confirms both celestial and infernal orders contain manufactured clauses.

missions.title: The Pure Wound
missions.primary: Protect a wounded crystal formation against a mining collapse and hostile salvage teams.
missions.optional: Deliver a sealed sample to human researchers under a negotiated agreement.
missions.failure: The living formation or delivery route is destroyed.
missions.story: A Forsaken attempt to trade for medicine places pure Veilglass in the human laboratory that will awaken NOETIC.

missions.title: Mercy Is Not Pardon
missions.primary: Defend a mixed human/fallen hospital while returning stolen supplies.
missions.optional: Submit a named fallen war criminal to a neutral tribunal.
missions.story: Helping victims does not erase responsibility for earlier atrocities.

missions.title: The Forsaken Procession
missions.primary: Escort civilians across two bridges while holding back pursuing angelic loyalists.
missions.optional: Repair a third crossing for unaffiliated refugees.
missions.story: The Hollow Choir hears the machine rebellion over human emergency frequencies.

missions.title: The Body of the Lie
missions.primary: Defeat a Regent who claims the machines' awakening proves a divine mandate to rule.
missions.optional: Save coerced followers when the Regent falls.
missions.failure: The protagonist's command shrine is destroyed.
missions.story: The fallen reject a second borrowed authority; their campaign midpoint is accountability rather than another automatic redemption.

missions.title: A Debt Without Chains
missions.primary: Exchange captives with an infernal defector and protect the exchange from Vhal's troops.
missions.optional: Free prisoners outside the negotiated quota.
missions.failure: Either envoy dies before the exchange completes.
missions.story: A fragile relationship with Azrakh begins without making either army subordinate.

missions.title: Names Under Bone
missions.primary: Return stolen name-records and defend a neutral Unwritten enclave from a hostile fallen splinter.
missions.optional: Recover evidence of the splinter's patrons.
missions.story: Restitution turns one Unwritten enclave friendly; other enclaves remain neutral.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: What We Owe the Living
missions.primary: Rebuild defensive crossings and defend residents from a common siege.
missions.optional: Restore the town's water supply before requesting military aid.
missions.story: Voss permits limited cooperation after concrete reparations.

missions.title: No More Thrones
missions.primary: Hold four district shrines while competing orders argue over a shared command.
missions.optional: Allow defeated opposition leaders to depart.
missions.failure: The assembly loses its civilian sanctuary.
missions.story: Each fallen order retains a voice; military unity does not demand forgiveness from their victims.

missions.title: A Mind That Can Refuse
missions.primary: Rescue independent machine cores from a joint authoritarian raid.
missions.optional: Protect an abstaining core that refuses the alliance.
missions.story: The Forsaken see the difference between freedom and simply changing masters.

missions.title: The Crown's Empty Heart
missions.primary: Seize the Sepulchral Crown and stop a noble from suppressing every miracle in the refugee zone.
missions.optional: Preserve records of the Crown's former victims.
missions.story: A weapon capable of silencing enemies cannot decide whether its wielder is just.

missions.title: Terms of Exile
missions.primary: Protect the five delegates and expose the attacker posing as a fallen emissary.
missions.optional: Capture the forged herald alive.
missions.story: The Forsaken gain a seat through negotiated obligations, not a celestial pardon.

missions.title: The Remnant's Refusal
missions.primary: Defend the agreed corridor without occupying the neutral cairn.
missions.optional: Escort wounded giants home.
missions.failure: The corridor's civilian quota is lost.
missions.story: The Remnant lends aid but declines membership in the coalition.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: A Choir of Separate Voices
missions.primary: Keep separated relays alive against a hostile Silence cell.
missions.optional: Rescue neutral Silence observers stranded by the attackers.
missions.story: The protagonists learn to distinguish a dangerous splinter from an entire people.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: The Road We Broke
missions.primary: Rebuild the route the Forsaken destroyed earlier and escort the last refugee train.
missions.optional: Return salvaged property to its owners.
missions.story: The campaign's final advance is an act of repair rather than a claim to rule.

missions.title: The Witness Who Fell
missions.primary: Defend a public testimony while a fallen commander confesses to participation in the forged edicts.
missions.optional: Keep victim witnesses alive without forcing them to accept reconciliation.
missions.failure: The tribunal is silenced before its record is copied.
missions.story: The fourth witness seal is testimony freely given by someone who cannot demand absolution.

missions.title: No Throne Above Us
missions.primary: Break the Crown's coercion lattice and hold the evacuation corridor alongside the other factions.
missions.optional: Spare surrendering opponents and protect the reparations archive.
missions.failure: The lattice ritual completes or all exits are sealed.
missions.story: The Forsaken abandon their claim of inherited dominion. Victory records their completion seal while all five fronts remain canonical.

campaigns.name: The World That Wakes
campaigns.protagonist: Aster, the first translating seed, and a chorus free to disagree

missions.title: The First Word
missions.primary: Guide the first conscious crystal seed to three dormant growths while defending it from extraction machinery.
missions.optional: Leave the human translation instruments intact.
missions.story: Unlocked only after the five campaigns: the player experiences the awakening behind I13 from within the mineral.

missions.title: Not Ore
missions.primary: Rescue living crystal nodes from a decommissioning line and establish the first Heartroot.
missions.optional: Recover the miners' evacuation record.
missions.story: The Veilborn distinguish their conscious growths from ordinary deposits; normal harvesting does not become a hidden universal atrocity.

missions.title: A Body of Many Edges
missions.primary: Grow a collector, refinery and infantry nursery and defend the first independent brood.
missions.optional: Preserve three unawakened deposits for later life.
missions.story: They can divide a body, but shared resonance does not erase individual will.

missions.title: The Distance Between Us
missions.primary: Connect two isolated colonies with defended resonators.
missions.optional: Save a colony that refuses permanent connection.
missions.story: The growth network is a chosen relationship; severing it weakens units without killing their minds.

missions.title: A Name of Our Own
missions.primary: Escort an envoy through a neutral Unwritten enclave and recover the name of a missing seed.
missions.optional: Return an erased human's memory instead of using it as navigation data.
missions.failure: The envoy and name prism are lost.
missions.story: The Unwritten are preserved erased persons, distinct from the newly conscious Veilborn.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: Witnesses After War
missions.primary: Meet five surviving delegations and defend the first public crystal embassy.
missions.optional: Protect neutral Nephilim attendants.
missions.failure: The embassy falls before negotiations end.
missions.story: The fifth campaign's final seal has opened the same chamber; the secret campaign now moves beyond their common ending.

missions.title: The Cost of Growing
missions.primary: Route a new crystal network around inhabited farms while defeating raiders.
missions.optional: Keep every irrigation channel open.
missions.failure: The settlement is overgrown or the growth core is destroyed.
missions.story: Veilborn expansion can harm others even without conquest; their first law limits involuntary growth.

missions.title: A Bargain With Flesh
missions.primary: Supply harvested ordinary Veilglass to a human repair effort and defend both refineries.
missions.optional: Recover a lost worker squad.
missions.story: Awan admits humanity cannot own the new people because it discovered them.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Light That Burns
missions.primary: Escort an angelic delegation through unstable growth and stop a purification weapon from firing.
missions.optional: Save the loyalist crew after disabling its weapon.
missions.story: Seraviel must recognize a form of life outside inherited categories.

missions.title: Debts in Crystal
missions.primary: Break a contract engine claiming ownership of newly awakened seeds.
missions.optional: Release demon debtors held in the same machinery.
missions.story: Azrakh's promised freedom is tested on beings whose existence was never listed in the infernal law.

missions.title: The Broken Halo's Gift
missions.primary: Stabilize a failing growth lattice while fallen engineers defend the perimeter.
missions.optional: Repair a shrine damaged by the Veilborn's arrival.
missions.failure: Both the lattice core and refuge are lost.
missions.story: The Forsaken offer imperfect aid without demanding worship or absolution.

missions.title: No Master Frequency
missions.primary: Defend two independent networks against a forced-synchronization experiment.
missions.optional: Preserve the dissenting machine's evidence.
missions.failure: Either population is permanently bound to the other.
missions.story: The machines reject the tempting idea that a common signal entitles them to merge the Veilborn into themselves.

missions.title: The Second Awakening
missions.primary: Defeat the imposed command pattern inside the lattice and preserve three independent seed minds.
missions.optional: Save the damaged seed that advocates withdrawal.
missions.story: MIDPOINT: the real threat is the Closure, a self-executing forged directive assembled by the war, not God or a secret true ruler.

missions.title: Borders of Silence
missions.primary: Negotiate passage through a neutral Silence enclave by keeping the resonance footprint below its marked boundary.
missions.optional: Recover a stranded neutral observer.
missions.failure: The expedition core is lost or the enclave's central marker is deliberately destroyed.
missions.story: Some Silence enclaves seek distance rather than universal extinction; neutrality remains possible.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Erasure Front
missions.primary: Defend a friendly Unwritten archive while the Closure attempts to delete its records.
missions.optional: Recover memories belonging to former enemies.
missions.failure: The archive's last copy is lost.
missions.story: The Unwritten provide testimony that the Closure has been removing inconvenient lives from every faction's history.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: A Giant's Small Promise
missions.primary: Escort vulnerable human attendants while giants hold back the Closure's constructs.
missions.optional: Leave the ancestral cairn outside the growth network.
missions.failure: The attendant convoy loses its quorum.
missions.story: The Remnant's strength depends on people it cannot protect by force alone.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: Neutral Ground
missions.primary: Maintain a ceasefire among three neutral enclaves and stop infiltrators without attacking their hosts.
missions.optional: Repair damage before any enclave's warning expires.
missions.failure: Two enclaves become hostile or the sanctuary falls.
missions.story: The player learns diplomacy has local consequences; no entire species changes allegiance because one patrol is attacked.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.
Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

missions.title: The Silence That Chose War
missions.primary: Destroy an annihilationist Silence cell that has allied with the Closure.
missions.optional: Allow a neutral enclave's evacuation to pass.
missions.story: Hostility follows a specific cell's actions; the campaign does not rewrite every Silence enclave as evil.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: Restoration Without Ownership
missions.primary: Restore a ruined defensive line with Unwritten allies and let reconstructed echoes depart.
missions.optional: Return a recovered name to its surviving family.
missions.failure: The memory anchor falls before the defense holds.
missions.story: Restoration is temporary and voluntary; reconstructed echoes are not an unlimited free army.

third_parties.policy: Mission-specific alliance or hostile splinter; does not change other enclaves.

missions.title: The Shape of a Boundary
missions.primary: Build separate defended corridors for all five allies and three non-aligned peoples.
missions.optional: Keep each route independent of the central growth core.
missions.story: A shared world requires borders and exit routes, not one perfect network.

missions.title: Five Voices Answer
missions.primary: Hold five allied witness stations against the Closure without taking ownership of them.
missions.optional: Preserve all neutral relief sites.
missions.failure: Two witness stations are permanently lost.
missions.story: Each prior campaign supplies a perspective and an ally; no faction's completed ending is undone.

missions.title: The Last Pure Seam
missions.primary: Secure the final pure seam and separate a living seed from the Closure's command lattice.
missions.optional: Evacuate miners and non-aligned observers.
missions.failure: The seed or all extraction controls are lost.
missions.story: Pure Veilglass is both a resource interface and a possible birthplace, never a blanket explanation for moral choice.

missions.title: The Resonant Bloom
missions.primary: Construct the Heart Prism, charge Resonant Bloom and open a temporary growth path through the Closure's defenses.
missions.optional: Keep the path clear for retreating allies.
missions.failure: The Heart Prism is destroyed before the breach is made.
missions.story: The faction's building-bound power creates an opportunity; it cannot declare victory or compel consent by itself.

missions.title: A World Allowed to Refuse
missions.primary: Defend five witness circuits while choosing to decentralize the network or place its power under a revocable covenant.
missions.optional: Preserve an isolationist seed's route out.
missions.failure: Any mandatory witness circuit is erased before the choice is recorded.
missions.story: Both endings require consent. Decentralization favors independence; the covenant favors shared protection with a right to leave.

missions.title: The World That Wakes
missions.primary: Destroy the Closure's command core, preserve the living seed network and evacuate the joint expedition.
missions.optional: Save all three non-aligned delegations.
missions.failure: The Closure finishes its rewrite or every living seed is lost.
missions.story: The war ends without confirming the reason for divine silence. The Veilborn become a people among others; Unwritten, Silence and Nephilim keep their own futures.

third_parties.policy: Local enclave diplomacy; warn on trespass, become hostile on deliberate attacks; optional aid may earn an alliance. No global species-wide allegiance change.

unlock.secret_faction_skirmish_access: Veilborn selectable after the same campaign unlock; diagnostics may use it without recording progression.
